method.function_credit: new-side hunk lines (git show -U0) mapped to lizard function spans in that revision; pure deletions credit the old-side function; identity = ast-qualified name (Class.method / outer.inner), lizard name as fallback
method.rank_A: (commits_in_window / max) x (ccn_at_HEAD / max_ccn); ties by ccn; zero-churn functions follow by ccn
method.rank_B: ((commits + 2*fix_commits) / max) x (ccn / max_ccn) -- a fix counts three times
method.excerpt: same line budget as today's Source block; whole functions +/-3 lines, greedy in rank order; the overflowing function is truncated and filling stops (mirrors _clip)
method.coupling: commits touching the hotspot's top-3 rank-A functions; every other celery/*.py (tests under t/ excluded) function touched in those commits counted; rank by shared commits
method.age: git blame -w at HEAD, author-time, days before the scan timestamp
method.rank_C: churn-only control: commits in window, ties by fix count then ccn; same fill policy as A
